features.name: Tokenized Checkout v2
features.description: Modern API v2 with /auth/grant-token, /payment/create, and /payment/execute. Under active validation pending live sandbox E2E test runs.

features.name: Tokenized Checkout v1.2.0-beta
features.description: Backward-compatible mapping for legacy v1.2 endpoints and response shapes.

features.name: Token Lifecycle Cache & Mutex
features.description: Prevents the catastrophic 2 calls/hr lockout on v2 by caching tokens with proactive 50-minute refresh and single-flight concurrency.

features.name: Amount & Invoice Verification Guard
features.description: Cryptographically and numerically verifies that execute response amounts match the initial database invoice before order confirmation.

features.name: Auto-Query Timeout Reconciliation
features.description: Automatically falls back to queryPayment on 30s execute timeouts to prevent zombie transactions.

features.name: Agreements & 1-Click Pay
features.description: Customer account binding and 1-click repeat checkouts requiring PIN entry only.

features.name: Auth & Capture
features.description: Pre-authorization hold with strictly enforced one-time capture or void.

features.name: Refunds & Refund Status
features.description: Up to 10 partial refunds against the maximum refundable amount within 60 days.

features.name: AWS SNS Webhook & Signature Verification
features.description: Validates official bKash AWS SNS notifications with X.509 RSA certificate fetching and signature verification.

features.name: React Client Hook (useBkash)
features.description: Type-safe React hook with idle -> creating -> awaiting_user -> verifying -> success state machine.

features.name: React Native WebView (<BkashCheckout/>)
features.description: URL interception, in-app browser mode, and hardware back-button handler.

features.name: Express Subpath Adapter
features.description: Pre-built routes for /create, /callback, and /webhook.

features.name: Next.js Route Handler Adapter
features.description: App Router and Pages API route handlers.

features.name: Local Mock Simulator
features.description: Local mock server for deterministic CI testing without credentials.

features.name: Dynamic Charging v1
features.description: Fixed, percentage, and slab-based fee calculation for aggregators and sub-merchants. Scheduled for Phase 4.

features.name: Payouts & Disbursements (B2C/B2B)
features.description: Automated salary, vendor, and agent disbursements. Scheduled for Phase 4.

features.name: Vue 3 Composable
features.description: Reactive useBkash composable for Vue 3 and Nuxt. Scheduled for Phase 5.

features.name: Angular Service
features.description: RxJS-based BkashService for Angular applications. Scheduled for Phase 5.

features.name: Fastify Plugin
features.description: Native Fastify plugin with typed schemas. Scheduled for Phase 5.

features.name: Hono / Cloudflare Workers Adapter
features.description: Edge-runtime adapter for Cloudflare Workers, Fastly, and Deno. Scheduled for Phase 5.

features.name: NestJS Dynamic Module
features.description: BkashModule with injectable services and controllers. Scheduled for Phase 5.
